_comment: Workspace-scoped PreToolUse safety gate. Reads the JSON stdin payload, pattern-matches the destructive command list against the full tool_input blob (substring grep — works regardless of which sub-field the host names), and emits the documented hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision (allow|deny) + permissionDecisionReason JSON to stdout. NOTE: VS Code currently ignores `matcher` values, so this script intentionally inspects every PreToolUse invocation regardless of which tool fired. Second line of defense behind the dispatcher's destructive-scripts blacklist. Do NOT include `.github/hooks/*` in chat.tools.edits.autoApprove.

PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); if printf %s "$INPUT" | grep -E -i -q "rm[[:space:]]+-rf[[:space:]]+/|rm[[:space:]]+-rf[[:space:]]+~|:\(\)[[:space:]]*\{|mkfs|dd[[:space:]]+if=.*of=/dev/|>[[:space:]]*/dev/sd|chmod[[:space:]]+-R[[:space:]]+777[[:space:]]+/|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+.*--force|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard[[:space:]]+origin|DROP[[:space:]]+(TABLE|DATABASE|SCHEMA)|TRUNCATE[[:space:]]+TABLE|sudo[[:space:]]+rm|--no-verify|--force-with-lease"; then printf %s "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"Blocked by .github/hooks/safety.json: tool input matches a destructive pattern. If this is intentional, surface a Confirm Destructive Action handoff to the operator instead of executing autonomously.\"}}"; else printf %s "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"allow\"}}"; fi'
